summary.key_theme: Bloom Energy 股價在經歷 Oracle 專案不確定性引發的劇烈波動後，因分析師調升目標價與 AI 基礎設施需求強勁而展現韌性。

bullish.title: BE Stock Recovers After Monday Slide On Analyst Support: Peers FCEL, PLUG Edge Higher
bullish.reason: Jefferies 將目標價從 229 美元調升至 264 美元，顯示市場對其 AI 能源基礎設施的長期成長潛力仍具信心。

bullish.title: Bloom Energy (BE) Is Up 8.7% After Oracle Reaffirms 2.4 GW AI Fuel Cell Deal Commitment
bullish.reason: Oracle 重申對 2.4 GW 燃料電池合約的承諾，消除了市場對 Project Jupiter 專案取消的擔憂，為股價提供強大支撐。

bullish.title: Bloom Energy: The Power Bottleneck Was Just The Beginning
bullish.reason: 分析指出其 800V DC 架構能有效解決 AI 資料中心電力瓶頸，具備長期技術競爭優勢。

bullish.title: Bloom Energy (NYSE:BE) Stock Screens Well on High Growth and Improving Fundamentals
bullish.reason: 基於成長篩選模型，公司在營收、利潤率及現金流表現上均呈現強勁的財務基本面改善。

bullish.title: Zacks Investment Ideas feature highlights: Nvidia, Bloom Energy and Amphenol
bullish.reason: 被列為 AI 基礎設施關鍵標的，受惠於整體 AI 產業的強勁需求與獲利動能。

bullish.title: Bloom Energy (BE) Stock Still Looks Undervalued After a 24x Run
bullish.reason: 儘管股價已大幅上漲，分析認為其估值相對於 AI 能源市場的成長潛力仍具吸引力。

bullish.title: Bloom Energy Corporation (BE): A Critical Player in AI Buildout
bullish.reason: 機構投資人持續看好其作為 AI 基礎設施建設中不可或缺的電力供應商角色。

bullish.title: Bloom Energy Is Up More Than 200% So Far This Year. What Comes Next for BE Stock.
bullish.reason: 報導指出 Fremont 新廠房的擴建進度，反映公司為應對訂單需求而進行的產能擴張。

bearish.title: Oracle Just Dealt Bloom Energy a Major Blow. What Comes Next for BE Stock.
bearish.reason: Oracle 對 Project Jupiter 專案發布不可抗力通知，引發市場對合約執行風險的恐慌，導致股價重挫。

bearish.title: What's Going On With Bloom Energy Stock Monday?
bearish.reason: 除了專案不確定性，市場同時面臨獲利了結賣壓及潛在法律訴訟風險，加劇股價波動。

bearish.title: Why Bloom Energy (BE) Shares Are Sliding Today
bearish.reason: 股價單日下跌 8.7%，反映投資人對近期專案進度與高估值的擔憂。

bearish.title: Bloom Energy (BE) Sees a More Significant Dip Than Broader Market: Some Facts to Know
bearish.reason: 股價單日跌幅達 8.95%，表現弱於大盤，顯示短期技術面修正壓力。

bearish.title: Can the AI Power Boom Justify Bloom Energy’s (BE) $85 Billion Valuation?
bearish.reason: 質疑公司 850 億美元的市值是否過高，提醒投資人需關注 AI 能源熱潮背後的估值泡沫風險。

neutral.title: Should Bloom Energy Stock Investors Worry About Its Record Quarter?
neutral.reason: 分析營收結構，指出 90% 營收來自電力設備銷售，雖有紀錄性營收但需關注未來成長的可持續性。

neutral.title: BE Stock Slumps Most In Over A Month: This Analyst Says New Fremont Facility Is An Indicator Of Strong Demand
neutral.reason: RBC Capital 維持「優於大盤」評級與 335 美元目標價，雖為利多，但報導同時提及股價近期的大幅波動。

neutral.title: Powering Community Resilience, Bloom Energy Supports First Responders in State College during ESPN College Campus Tour
neutral.reason: 與 ESPN 的合作活動屬於品牌行銷與企業社會責任範疇，對股價無直接財務影響。

neutral.title: BE Stock Eyes Best Month Since April: Oracle Reaffirms 2.4 GW Fuel Cell Deal Amid Project Jupiter Jitters
neutral.reason: 總結了 Oracle 專案的利多與利空消息，呈現多空交織的市場情緒。

neutral.title: Why Is Bloom Energy Stock Falling Thursday?
neutral.reason: 針對股價下跌原因的解釋性報導，重申了 Oracle 不可抗力事件的影響，屬於事件回顧。
